details: The US Senate has postponed a vote on the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act (CLARITY Act) until September, missing its pre-recess deadline. This delay is attributed to unresolved disputes, including an ethics provision concerning President Trump's cryptocurrency holdings, creating ongoing regulatory uncertainty for the digital asset industry. The bill aims to establish a clear framework for cryptocurrency oversight, primarily dividing responsibilities between the SEC and CFTC.
title: US Senate Delays Key Crypto Regulation Bill

details: Iran is reportedly close to an agreement with Oman regarding new shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz. However, Tehran reiterated that the strategic waterway will only be fully reopened if the United States meets its comprehensive demands, including compensation, an end to sanctions, and a cessation of military threats. The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps emphasized the necessity of full US acceptance of Iran's conditions.
title: Iran Ties Hormuz Reopening to US Concessions Amid Oman Deal

details: Brazil's Finance Minister, Dario Durigan, has paused a public consultation on cryptocurrency taxation. This decision aims to circumvent politically sensitive fiscal debates in the lead-up to the country's October 2026 presidential election. Consequently, the tax treatment for stablecoin transfers and the use of virtual assets for international payments will remain undefined for the time being.
title: Brazil Freezes Crypto Tax Plans Ahead of October Elections

details: The latest US jobs report for July indicated an unexpected decline of 23,000 jobs, which has reduced market expectations for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike in September. In response, gold rallied as a traditional safe-haven asset. Bitcoin, however, saw only a modest increase of approximately 0.7%, demonstrating some market resilience amidst an otherwise cautious investor sentiment.
title: Weak US Jobs Data Lowers Fed Hike Odds, Bitcoin Shows Resilience
